verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents workflow automation triggers (notify/update/validate), automatic bank feed import/categorization, Blueprints, and MCP-based agent access explicitly described as enabling 'fully autonomous agents [that] monitor, reason, and act without human input,' with customer quotes describing autonomous-style bookkeeping via Claude. However, this evidence is largely vendor marketing rather than technical documentation of scheduling, triggers, or persistent background execution mechanics, and the MCP endpoint is sign-in-gated with no independent verification of autonomous runs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on proof of unattended background automation running without human triggering, detailed docs on automation scheduling/persistence, and third-party corroboration beyond customer testimonials.
